bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $41，创 2月以来新低

read.en: AAOI fell 9.8% on Nov 18 to $40.79, trading $37.60–42.32 on heavy volume (1.46x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($46.8), 10-day ($48.7), 30-day ($69.3), 100-day ($100.1) and 200-day ($115.0); all but the 200-day are falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 16 ($57.08), and RSI is 29.9.
read.zh: AAOI 11月18日下跌 9.8%，收于 $40.79，盘中区间 $37.60–42.32，成交量放大（为 20 日均量的 1.46 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$46.8）、10 日（$48.7）、30 日（$69.3）、100 日（$100.1）和 200 日均线（$115.0）下方；除 200 日均线外均在下行。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月16日起看空（$57.08），RSI 为 29.9。

read.en: The close broke the $44.8–45.2, $42.65 and $41 supports, now resistance, and the $37.60 low was the lowest since Feb 5. Resistance is $42.3–42.7 (Nov 18 high, Nov 17 low), then $44.8–45.2 (Nov 16 and 6 lows) and $46.8–48.2 (5-day, Nov 16–17 highs). Support is $40, then $37.0–37.6 (Nov 18 and Feb 5 lows). A close above $42.7 would target $45; below $37.6, $37.0.

r.en: Nov 16 low $44.78; Nov 6 low $45.15; Nov 17 close $45.22, lost
